projectSummary: Contributes the specific finding that the abdominal part has an identifiable, separately traceable nerve supply, which supports treating the muscle as having more than two functionally separable parts.

publication.statusSource: Crossref REST API works record plus the Crossref/Retraction Watch CSV export, both fetched 2026-09-13

study.intervention: Cadaveric macroscopic dissection of the nerve supply to the abdominal part.
study.population: Fifty pectoralis major muscles and their supplying nerve branches, from 27 formalin-fixed anatomical specimens, were studied by macroscopic dissection to identify the position, intramuscular course and target of the branches innervating the abdominal part.

title: Extramuscular and Intramuscular Course of the Nerve Innervating the Abdominal Part of the Pectoralis Major Muscle: An Anatomical Study with Regard to Transaxillary Endoscopic Subpectoral Breast Augmentation.
